sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier; found at incoming inspection on BR-310.

findings.why: Chisone (SUP-C) has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material. BR-310 is made from that alloy, and the 8D was raised on BR-310 itself. The 8D is still open: the root cause is under investigation and the corrective action is not verified. The packing change is covered by DEV-125, which is valid until 2027-01-31. The open issue is still a blocker.
